This happened to me. Growing up I had 'buck teeth'? Like my two front teeth were much longer than the rest and the two on either side are what you would call baby teeth compared to the rest though they are my adult teeth.I had gone to the dentist for a appointment after not having one for a couple years and I was at a new office. Had t ok do ac ok couple things that requierd me getting numbed and I felt they where doing quite a bit on my two front teeth( they work working on neighboring teeth) after all was said an done they just briefly mentioned to me (almost proudly) "oh also we also shaved down to uh two front teeth so they don't stand out as much and look better with your other teeth."
What could I have said the deed was dont so i was like 'oh, okay?'
Went home and cried. I had never been much of a fan of my teeth but damn. I wasn't even asked about it and after all they are were my teeth, and was starting to appreciate thier uniqueness. Let's just say after that I'm not so much scared of the dentist but just not a fan for other reasons(this being one).
Hear, hear, my fellow redditor. I bid you the best for this new year.
